All this nonsense about defending yourself from the government was never the intent, it's a straw man put up by those who want to remove your right to arms, keep you battling the straw man and you won't realise the real reasons for 2a.

A "well regulated militia" can only be created from people who know how to use a gun. If everyone in a state has zero gun experience you cannot create a militia or army from them without a lot of work. Persuade enough people that guns are something to be avoided and you'll have a hard time creating a militia or army when one is needed. The British managed to do this purely by accident, shooting as a hobby was discouraged, fell out of fashion and our recruits during the Boer war were lousy shots in comparison with the other side. The folly of this was noted by Lord Roberts and Lord Baden-Powell (the father of scouting) who sought to address the problem by promoting shooting as a competition sport for the working classes.

I hold the opinion that your 2a was a very clever attempt to stop a similar situation occurring in the USA.
